# Reporting query plans and performance baseline

Generated by `scripts/run-reporting-performance-baseline.ps1`. Every figure below is measured against a real PostgreSQL 18 cluster, not estimated.

## Fixture

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Captured at (UTC) | 2026-09-08 19:05:08Z |
| Clients / websites / environments | 6 / 24 / 48 |
| Endpoints | 96 |
| Monitors | 192 |
| Check results | 1,667,520 |
| History retained | 90 days |
| Iterations per scenario | 10 |

## Measured latency

| Scenario | Fastest | Median | P95 | Slowest | NFR-02 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Dashboard - unfiltered, 30 days | 5,604 ms | 5,984 ms | 6,254 ms | 6,254 ms | **over budget** |
| Dashboard - one client, 30 days | 1,473 ms | 1,609 ms | 1,725 ms | 1,725 ms | within budget |
| Dashboard - unfiltered, 90 days | 14,270 ms | 15,314 ms | 16,256 ms | 16,256 ms | **over budget** |
| Dashboard - viewer scoped to one client, 30 days | 1,459 ms | 1,575 ms | 1,695 ms | 1,695 ms | within budget |
| CSV export - unfiltered, 30 days | 1,248 ms | 1,310 ms | 1,354 ms | 1,354 ms | not a dashboard |
| Report dataset - unfiltered, 90 days | 13,462 ms | 14,462 ms | 20,009 ms | 20,009 ms | not a dashboard |

## Plans

Captured with `auto_explain` (`log_analyze`, `log_buffers`, `log_nested_statements`), so each plan is the one PostgreSQL chose for the statement the application issued. The durations inside a plan include per-node instrumentation and are therefore higher than the measured latency above.

### Dashboard - unfiltered, 30 days

The default landing view: every monitor the reader can see, over the default window.

	FROM (

	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e

	    WHERE e.id = ANY ($1)
	) AS s
	GROUP BY s."Key"

duration: 2501.069 ms  plan:
	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT result.endpoint_monitor_id, snapshot.configuration_fingerprint,
	    snapshot.schema_version, snapshot.current_truth_generation, result.monitor_source
	FROM raw_results result JOIN web_health.check_configuration_snapshot snapshot
	    ON snapshot.logical_check_id = result.logical_check_id
	WHERE result.counts_for_uptime ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

duration: 0.022 ms  plan:
	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT endpoint_monitor_id, min(comparability_identity), max(comparability_identity), bool_and(is_comparable)
	FROM covered_days WHERE eligible_count > 0 GROUP BY endpoint_monitor_id

duration: 4.079 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT e1.id, e1.endpoint_id, c.name, w.name, e3.name, e3.is_production, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, COALESCE(e2.owner_subject_id, w.owner_subject_id), CASE
	    WHEN e4.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL OR e4.confirmed_status = 'Disabled' THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e4.confirmed_status
	END, e4.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = e1.id AND i.status = ANY ($1)), e2.is_enabled AND e2.deleted_at IS NULL AND e3.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.is_enabled AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_active AND c.deleted_at IS NULL, e1.scheduling_enabled, e1.is_enabled, e1.interval_seconds, e1.next_due_at, (
	    SELECT l.completed_at
	    FROM web_health.logical_check AS l
	    LEFT JOIN web_health.check_result AS c0 ON l.id = c0.logical_check_id AND l.endpoint_monitor_id = c0.endpoint_monitor_id
	    WHERE e1.id = l.endpoint_monitor_id AND l.source = 'Scheduled' AND l.state = 'Completed' AND c0.logical_check_id IS NOT NULL AND c0.current_state_disposition = 'Current' AND l.completed_at IS NOT NULL
	    ORDER BY l.completed_at DESC, l.id DESC
	    LIMIT 1)
	FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	INNER JOIN (
	    SELECT e0.id, e0.endpoint_id, e0.interval_seconds, e0.is_enabled, e0.monitor_type, e0.next_due_at, e0.scheduling_enabled
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e0
	    WHERE e0.deleted_at IS NULL
	) AS e1 ON e.id = e1.endpoint_id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e2 ON e1.endpoint_id = e2.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e3 ON e2.environment_id = e3.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e3.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e4 ON e1.id = e4.endpoint_monitor_id
	WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e1.monitor_type = $2
	ORDER BY c.name, w.name, e3.name, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, e1.id

duration: 6.553 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT e1.id, e1.endpoint_id, c.name, w.name, e3.name, e3.is_production, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, COALESCE(e2.owner_subject_id, w.owner_subject_id), CASE
	    WHEN e4.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL OR e4.confirmed_status = 'Disabled' THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e4.confirmed_status
	END, e4.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = e1.id AND i.status = ANY ($1)), e2.is_enabled AND e2.deleted_at IS NULL AND e3.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.is_enabled AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_active AND c.deleted_at IS NULL, e1.scheduling_enabled, e1.is_enabled, e1.interval_seconds, e1.next_due_at, (
	    SELECT l.completed_at
	    FROM web_health.logical_check AS l
	    LEFT JOIN web_health.check_result AS c0 ON l.id = c0.logical_check_id AND l.endpoint_monitor_id = c0.endpoint_monitor_id
	    WHERE e1.id = l.endpoint_monitor_id AND l.source = 'Scheduled' AND l.state = 'Completed' AND c0.logical_check_id IS NOT NULL AND c0.current_state_disposition = 'Current' AND l.completed_at IS NOT NULL
	    ORDER BY l.completed_at DESC, l.id DESC
	    LIMIT 1)
	FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	INNER JOIN (
	    SELECT e0.id, e0.endpoint_id, e0.interval_seconds, e0.is_enabled, e0.monitor_type, e0.next_due_at, e0.scheduling_enabled
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e0
	    WHERE e0.deleted_at IS NULL
	) AS e1 ON e.id = e1.endpoint_id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e2 ON e1.endpoint_id = e2.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e3 ON e2.environment_id = e3.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e3.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e4 ON e1.id = e4.endpoint_monitor_id
	WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL
	ORDER BY c.name, w.name, e3.name, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, e1.id

duration: 0.015 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT m.operation, m.last_started_at, m.last_succeeded_at, m.last_failed_at, m.last_duration_ms, m.failure_category, m.consecutive_failures
	FROM web_health.monitoring_runtime_state AS m
	ORDER BY m.operation
	Sort  (cost=0.01..0.02 rows=1 width=232) (actual time=0.013..0.014 rows=0.00 loops=1)
	  Sort Key: operation
	  Sort Method: quicksort  Memory: 25kB
	  ->  Seq Scan on monitoring_runtime_state m  (cost=0.00..0.00 rows=1 width=232) (actual time=0.006..0.007 rows=0.00 loops=1)

duration: 0.085 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT i0.id AS "Id", e.endpoint_id AS "EndpointId", e0.display_url AS "DisplayUrl", c.name AS "ClientName", e1.name AS "EnvironmentName", i0.issue_key AS "IssueKey", e.monitor_type AS "MonitorType", i0.severity AS "Severity", i0.status AS "Status", i0.opened_at AS "OpenedAt", i0.acknowledged_at AS "AcknowledgedAt", i0.owner_subject_id AS "OwnerSubjectId"
	FROM (
	    SELECT i.id, i.acknowledged_at, i.endpoint_monitor_id, i.issue_key, i.opened_at, i.owner_subject_id, i.severity, i.status
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY ($1) AND i.status = ANY ($2)
	    ORDER BY i.opened_at DESC, i.id
	    LIMIT $3
	) AS i0
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e ON i0.endpoint_monitor_id = e.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e0 ON e.endpoint_id = e0.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e1 ON e0.environment_id = e1.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e1.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	ORDER BY i0.opened_at DESC, i0.id

	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT result.endpoint_monitor_id, snapshot.configuration_fingerprint,
	    snapshot.schema_version, snapshot.current_truth_generation, result.monitor_source

	    WHEN e5.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL OR e5.confirmed_status = 'Disabled' THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e5.confirmed_status
	END, e5.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = e2.id AND i.status = ANY ($1)), e3.is_enabled AND e3.deleted_at IS NULL AND e4.deleted_at IS NULL AND w0.is_enabled AND w0.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_active AND c.deleted_at IS NULL, e2.scheduling_enabled, e2.is_enabled, e2.interval_seconds, e2.next_due_at, (
	    SELECT l.completed_at
	    FROM web_health.logical_check AS l
	    LEFT JOIN web_health.check_result AS c0 ON l.id = c0.logical_check_id AND l.endpoint_monitor_id = c0.endpoint_monitor_id
	    WHERE e2.id = l.endpoint_monitor_id AND l.source = 'Scheduled' AND l.state = 'Completed' AND c0.logical_check_id IS NOT NULL AND c0.current_state_disposition = 'Current' AND l.completed_at IS NOT NULL
	    ORDER BY l.completed_at DESC, l.id DESC
	    LIMIT 1)
	FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e0 ON e.environment_id = e0.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e0.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN (
	    SELECT e1.id, e1.endpoint_id, e1.interval_seconds, e1.is_enabled, e1.monitor_type, e1.next_due_at, e1.scheduling_enabled
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e1
	    WHERE e1.deleted_at IS NULL
	) AS e2 ON e.id = e2.endpoint_id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e3 ON e2.endpoint_id = e3.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e4 ON e3.environment_id = e4.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w0 ON e4.website_id = w0.id

	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e5 ON e2.id = e5.endpoint_monitor_id

	ORDER BY c.name, w0.name, e4.name, e3.display_url, e2.monitor_type, e2.id

	    ELSE e5.confirmed_status

	    SELECT l.completed_at
	    FROM web_health.logical_check AS l
	    LEFT JOIN web_health.check_result AS c0 ON l.id = c0.logical_check_id AND l.endpoint_monitor_id = c0.endpoint_monitor_id

	    ORDER BY l.completed_at DESC, l.id DESC
	    LIMIT 1)
	FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e0 ON e.environment_id = e0.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e0.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN (
	    SELECT e1.id, e1.endpoint_id, e1.interval_seconds, e1.is_enabled, e1.monitor_type, e1.next_due_at, e1.scheduling_enabled
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e1
	    WHERE e1.deleted_at IS NULL
	) AS e2 ON e.id = e2.endpoint_id

	WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.client_id = $2
	ORDER BY c.name, w0.name, e4.name, e3.display_url, e2.monitor_type, e2.id

	    SELECT aggregate.*,

	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (

duration: 5945.994 ms  plan:
	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT result.endpoint_monitor_id, snapshot.configuration_fingerprint,
	    snapshot.schema_version, snapshot.current_truth_generation, result.monitor_source
	FROM raw_results result JOIN web_health.check_configuration_snapshot snapshot
	    ON snapshot.logical_check_id = result.logical_check_id
	WHERE result.counts_for_uptime ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

duration: 0.017 ms  plan:
	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT endpoint_monitor_id, min(comparability_identity), max(comparability_identity), bool_and(is_comparable)
	FROM covered_days WHERE eligible_count > 0 GROUP BY endpoint_monitor_id

	Query Text: SELECT e1.id, e1.endpoint_id, c.name, w.name, e3.name, e3.is_production, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, COALESCE(e2.owner_subject_id, w.owner_subject_id), CASE
	    WHEN e4.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL OR e4.confirmed_status = 'Disabled' THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e4.confirmed_status
	END, e4.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = e1.id AND i.status = ANY ($1)), e2.is_enabled AND e2.deleted_at IS NULL AND e3.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.is_enabled AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_active AND c.deleted_at IS NULL, e1.scheduling_enabled, e1.is_enabled, e1.interval_seconds, e1.next_due_at, (
	    SELECT l.completed_at
	    FROM web_health.logical_check AS l
	    LEFT JOIN web_health.check_result AS c0 ON l.id = c0.logical_check_id AND l.endpoint_monitor_id = c0.endpoint_monitor_id
	    WHERE e1.id = l.endpoint_monitor_id AND l.source = 'Scheduled' AND l.state = 'Completed' AND c0.logical_check_id IS NOT NULL AND c0.current_state_disposition = 'Current' AND l.completed_at IS NOT NULL
	    ORDER BY l.completed_at DESC, l.id DESC
	    LIMIT 1)
	FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	INNER JOIN (
	    SELECT e0.id, e0.endpoint_id, e0.interval_seconds, e0.is_enabled, e0.monitor_type, e0.next_due_at, e0.scheduling_enabled
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e0
	    WHERE e0.deleted_at IS NULL
	) AS e1 ON e.id = e1.endpoint_id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e2 ON e1.endpoint_id = e2.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e3 ON e2.environment_id = e3.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e3.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e4 ON e1.id = e4.endpoint_monitor_id
	WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e1.monitor_type = $2
	ORDER BY c.name, w.name, e3.name, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, e1.id

duration: 5.594 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT e1.id, e1.endpoint_id, c.name, w.name, e3.name, e3.is_production, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, COALESCE(e2.owner_subject_id, w.owner_subject_id), CASE
	    WHEN e4.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL OR e4.confirmed_status = 'Disabled' THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e4.confirmed_status
	END, e4.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = e1.id AND i.status = ANY ($1)), e2.is_enabled AND e2.deleted_at IS NULL AND e3.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.is_enabled AND w.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_active AND c.deleted_at IS NULL, e1.scheduling_enabled, e1.is_enabled, e1.interval_seconds, e1.next_due_at, (
	    SELECT l.completed_at
	    FROM web_health.logical_check AS l
	    LEFT JOIN web_health.check_result AS c0 ON l.id = c0.logical_check_id AND l.endpoint_monitor_id = c0.endpoint_monitor_id
	    WHERE e1.id = l.endpoint_monitor_id AND l.source = 'Scheduled' AND l.state = 'Completed' AND c0.logical_check_id IS NOT NULL AND c0.current_state_disposition = 'Current' AND l.completed_at IS NOT NULL
	    ORDER BY l.completed_at DESC, l.id DESC
	    LIMIT 1)
	FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	INNER JOIN (
	    SELECT e0.id, e0.endpoint_id, e0.interval_seconds, e0.is_enabled, e0.monitor_type, e0.next_due_at, e0.scheduling_enabled
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e0
	    WHERE e0.deleted_at IS NULL
	) AS e1 ON e.id = e1.endpoint_id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e2 ON e1.endpoint_id = e2.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e3 ON e2.environment_id = e3.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e3.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e4 ON e1.id = e4.endpoint_monitor_id
	WHERE e.deleted_at IS NULL
	ORDER BY c.name, w.name, e3.name, e2.display_url, e1.monitor_type, e1.id

duration: 0.014 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT m.operation, m.last_started_at, m.last_succeeded_at, m.last_failed_at, m.last_duration_ms, m.failure_category, m.consecutive_failures
	FROM web_health.monitoring_runtime_state AS m
	ORDER BY m.operation
	Sort  (cost=0.01..0.02 rows=1 width=232) (actual time=0.013..0.013 rows=0.00 loops=1)
	  Sort Key: operation
	  Sort Method: quicksort  Memory: 25kB
	  ->  Seq Scan on monitoring_runtime_state m  (cost=0.00..0.00 rows=1 width=232) (actual time=0.005..0.005 rows=0.00 loops=1)

duration: 0.095 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT i0.id AS "Id", e.endpoint_id AS "EndpointId", e0.display_url AS "DisplayUrl", c.name AS "ClientName", e1.name AS "EnvironmentName", i0.issue_key AS "IssueKey", e.monitor_type AS "MonitorType", i0.severity AS "Severity", i0.status AS "Status", i0.opened_at AS "OpenedAt", i0.acknowledged_at AS "AcknowledgedAt", i0.owner_subject_id AS "OwnerSubjectId"
	FROM (
	    SELECT i.id, i.acknowledged_at, i.endpoint_monitor_id, i.issue_key, i.opened_at, i.owner_subject_id, i.severity, i.status
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY ($1) AND i.status = ANY ($2)
	    ORDER BY i.opened_at DESC, i.id
	    LIMIT $3
	) AS i0
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e ON i0.endpoint_monitor_id = e.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e0 ON e.endpoint_id = e0.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e1 ON e0.environment_id = e1.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e1.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w.client_id = c.id
	ORDER BY i0.opened_at DESC, i0.id

	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT result.endpoint_monitor_id, snapshot.configuration_fingerprint,
	    snapshot.schema_version, snapshot.current_truth_generation, result.monitor_source

	    ON snapshot.logical_check_id = result.logical_check_id

duration: 1.702 ms  plan:
	Query Text: SELECT e2.id, e2.endpoint_id, c.name, w0.name, e4.name, e4.is_production, e3.display_url, e2.monitor_type, COALESCE(e3.owner_subject_id, w0.owner_subject_id), CASE
	    WHEN e5.endpoint_monitor_id IS NULL OR e5.confirmed_status = 'Disabled' THEN 'Unknown'
	    ELSE e5.confirmed_status
	END, e5.confirmed_at, (
	    SELECT count(*)::int
	    FROM web_health.incident AS i
	    WHERE i.endpoint_monitor_id = e2.id AND i.status = ANY ($1)), e3.is_enabled AND e3.deleted_at IS NULL AND e4.deleted_at IS NULL AND w0.is_enabled AND w0.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_active AND c.deleted_at IS NULL, e2.scheduling_enabled, e2.is_enabled, e2.interval_seconds, e2.next_due_at, (
	    SELECT l.completed_at
	    FROM web_health.logical_check AS l
	    LEFT JOIN web_health.check_result AS c0 ON l.id = c0.logical_check_id AND l.endpoint_monitor_id = c0.endpoint_monitor_id
	    WHERE e2.id = l.endpoint_monitor_id AND l.source = 'Scheduled' AND l.state = 'Completed' AND c0.logical_check_id IS NOT NULL AND c0.current_state_disposition = 'Current' AND l.completed_at IS NOT NULL
	    ORDER BY l.completed_at DESC, l.id DESC
	    LIMIT 1)
	FROM web_health.endpoint AS e
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e0 ON e.environment_id = e0.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w ON e0.website_id = w.id
	INNER JOIN (
	    SELECT e1.id, e1.endpoint_id, e1.interval_seconds, e1.is_enabled, e1.monitor_type, e1.next_due_at, e1.scheduling_enabled
	    FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e1
	    WHERE e1.deleted_at IS NULL
	) AS e2 ON e.id = e2.endpoint_id
	INNER JOIN web_health.endpoint AS e3 ON e2.endpoint_id = e3.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.environment AS e4 ON e3.environment_id = e4.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.website AS w0 ON e4.website_id = w0.id
	INNER JOIN web_health.client AS c ON w0.client_id = c.id
	LEFT JOIN web_health.endpoint_health AS e5 ON e2.id = e5.endpoint_monitor_id
	WHERE (w.client_id IN (
	    SELECT a.client_id
	    FROM web_health.access_grant AS a
	    WHERE a.user_id = $2 AND EXISTS (
	        SELECT 1
	        FROM web_health.app_user AS a0
	        WHERE a0.id = a.user_id AND NOT (a0.is_disabled)) AND a.effective_from <= $3 AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND (a.expires_at IS NULL OR a.expires_at > $4) AND a.client_id IS NOT NULL
	) OR e0.website_id IN (
	    SELECT a1.website_id
	    FROM web_health.access_grant AS a1
	    WHERE a1.user_id = $2 AND EXISTS (
	        SELECT 1
	        FROM web_health.app_user AS a2
	        WHERE a2.id = a1.user_id AND NOT (a2.is_disabled)) AND a1.effective_from <= $3 AND a1.revoked_at IS NULL AND (a1.expires_at IS NULL OR a1.expires_at > $4) AND a1.website_id IS NOT NULL
	) OR e.environment_id IN (
	    SELECT a3.environment_id
	    FROM web_health.access_grant AS a3
	    WHERE a3.user_id = $2 AND EXISTS (
	        SELECT 1
	        FROM web_health.app_user AS a4
	        WHERE a4.id = a3.user_id AND NOT (a4.is_disabled)) AND a3.effective_from <= $3 AND a3.revoked_at IS NULL AND (a3.expires_at IS NULL OR a3.expires_at > $4) AND a3.environment_id IS NOT NULL
	) OR e.id IN (
	    SELECT a5.endpoint_id
	    FROM web_health.access_grant AS a5
	    WHERE a5.user_id = $2 AND EXISTS (
	        SELECT 1
	        FROM web_health.app_user AS a6
	        WHERE a6.id = a5.user_id AND NOT (a6.is_disabled)) AND a5.effective_from <= $3 AND a5.revoked_at IS NULL AND (a5.expires_at IS NULL OR a5.expires_at > $4) AND a5.endpoint_id IS NOT NULL
	)) AND e.deleted_at IS NULL

	FROM web_health.endpoint_monitor AS e

duration: 6231.761 ms  plan:
	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT DISTINCT result.endpoint_monitor_id, snapshot.configuration_fingerprint,
	    snapshot.schema_version, snapshot.current_truth_generation, result.monitor_source
	FROM raw_results result JOIN web_health.check_configuration_snapshot snapshot
	    ON snapshot.logical_check_id = result.logical_check_id
	WHERE result.counts_for_uptime ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

duration: 0.022 ms  plan:
	Query Text: WITH archived_days AS (
	    SELECT aggregate.*,
	        aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start
	    FROM web_health.monitoring_daily_aggregate aggregate
	    WHERE aggregate.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND aggregate.raw_deletion_started_at IS NOT NULL
	        AND aggregate.utc_date >= ($2 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date <= ($3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
	        AND aggregate.utc_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' < $3
	), covered_days AS (
	    SELECT * FROM archived_days
	    WHERE day_start >= $2 AND day_start + interval '24 hours' <= $3
	), raw_results AS (
	    SELECT result.* FROM web_health.check_result result
	    WHERE result.endpoint_monitor_id = ANY($1)
	        AND result.measured_at >= $2 AND result.measured_at < $3
	        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM archived_days archive
	            WHERE archive.endpoint_monitor_id = result.endpoint_monitor_id
	                AND archive.utc_date = (result.measured_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date)
	)
	SELECT endpoint_monitor_id, min(comparability_identity), max(comparability_identity), bool_and(is_comparable)
	FROM covered_days WHERE eligible_count > 0 GROUP BY endpoint_monitor_id
